artifacts.purpose: Final model weights (Step 9's optimized FP16 state dict + reload metadata), copied byte-for-byte from optimized/best_optimized_model.pt.

Model architecture (Step 5 ModelArchitectureConfig) and problem/diffusion specification (Step 1 ProblemSpecification, with this checkpoint's actual diffusion_timesteps/vocab_size) needed to reconstruct the exact nn.Module before loading the weights.
Tokenizer vocabulary (Step 3 word<->id mapping + special tokens) required to turn new text prompts into token ids this model understands.
Step 3 image/text preprocessing contract (target size, pixel normalization, tokenizer settings) required to preprocess new inputs identically to training and to decode generated output correctly.
Condensed Step 6 (training) / Step 7 (winning experiment) / Step 8 (test evaluation) / Step 9 (optimization) results, for reproducibility without re-reading four separate report files.

round_trip_verification.verification_note: This project's own Linux sandbox tooling cannot import torch, so this exact check was run in a separate verified PyTorch 2.13.0 (CPU) environment against a staged copy of this SAME checkpoint file -- confirmed byte-identical by matching sha256 (see source_checkpoint.sha256 above) before the check ran. All four checks (state-dict tensor equality, forward() output equality, seeded generate() output equality) passed with max abs diff == 0.0, i.e. bit-for-bit identical, not merely close. Re-running `python -m backend.custom_model.model_storage` directly on this machine (with its real torch/mps) will repeat and re-confirm this same check locally.
